canonical_project: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Data Centre (Government BCDR)
owner: Government of North Macedonia / Ministry of Internal Affairs (beneficiary); CFCD Ministry of Finance (client); EU-funded (EuropeAid/132633/C/SER/MULTI)
notes: Purpose-built MoIA BCDR data centre, Ulica Vasko Karangeleski, cadastral parcel KP 2.19.1, 7500 Prilep; GFA 1,307 m2; design 06.2016-12.2017 (1X2STUDIO/Safege), construction 03.2018-05.2019 (contractor 4A-M Tirana, detailed design MEGARON Skopje), status BUILT; server room per TIA-942 / EN 1047-2, 60 racks phase 1 (7.2 kW/rack = ~0.43 MW) + 60 racks reserved phase 2; EU contract ~EUR 3.4m; EUmies Awards 2022 nominee. why_this_is_a_data_center: dedicated government BCDR facility for MoI IT systems with server rooms, redundant power, climate control, physical security ring. what_is_not_confirmed: current operational phase/occupancy, phase-2 build-out, grid connection details.
